tasks.goal: Compiler architecture and implementation plan for the A100 correctness-only run, derived from the recorded facts (chip F-facts, environment probes), the workload feature matrix and api-spec (107 constructs), and the injected A100 target knowledge (A100-NATIVE-OPERATOR; timing anchors not required under correctness_only). Deliverables: (1) docs/compiler-agent/COMPILER_ARCHITECTURE.md — a concise architecture choosing frontend, IR levels, backend boundary, native runtime boundary, register-allocation responsibility, work distribution and execution-model mapping, with explicit producer/consumer interfaces per stage, per-stage dump/observability for first-incorrect-stage localisation, RVV tail handling, applicable IME matrix lowering (tile/layout, accumulation type, register grouping, overlap restrictions, implicit control state from cited specification), 1/2/4/8-worker partitioning, workspace ownership, stage visibility and merge semantics, cache identity covering every bound source/target/option/grid/launch/argument-layout dependency, and the A100_COMPILER_FACTORY integration through a100_support/native_device.py; (2) docs/compiler-agent/ARCHITECTURE_CONSTRAINTS.json — schema_version 1, test_command, modules (responsibility-owned paths), stages (each with module and tests), ir_levels (each with representation_id, properties, passes including the basic optimizations CSE, DCE, constant folding/propagation, copy propagation, strength reduction, LICM, and verification/round-trip tests), behaviour properties with witness commands including the no-operator-name-dispatch witness (a build with an operator-name branch injected must fail the witness), and validation_checks — valid under `architecture-check --declaration-only`; (3) EXECUTION_MODEL.json recorded via the execution-model command citing recorded facts (work unit, workers default and max, distribution mechanism, partition policies, synchronization, safety, serial fallback); (4) EXECUTION_RESOURCES.json derived from facts (allowed_units, minimum_workers >= 2, instruction_patterns including a supported IME matrix-compute mnemonic, evidence citing active input facts, shared_resources groups citing active facts); (5) the implementation task DAG submitted through task-submit — concrete tasks with capability (coding unless truly review/debug/integration), purpose input, gate, dependencies from actual consumption, interfaces, acceptance and tests, covering at least: a small-operator end-to-end vertical slice (tagged vertical-slice, gate G4) through parse, semantic representation, lowering, assembly generation, assemble/link, QEMU execution and independent comparison including its one-worker and multi-worker paths; a matrix/IME slice with real IME instruction execution before matrix breadth; the declared api-spec surface implementation with the frontend coverage matrix (FRONTEND_COVERAGE.json, every construct implemented with evidence and covered parameters or declared-unsupported with a refusal witness); the basic optimizations as ordinary coding/input tasks with legality and result checks (never capability/purpose/tag optimization, never G9); the compile/run/full-scan driver in the compiler's own tools/ calling the same pipeline and the a100_support/native_device.py compile_case protocol with A100_COMPILER_FACTORY wiring; regression manifest preparation (regression-prepare) and executed comparison (regression-record); parallel evidence (1 vs multi-worker runtime measurement of one compiled artifact with worker split recorded) and resource-evidence representative cases (resource_evidence=true manifest rows bound to run, case and artifact with executed instruction counts and overlapping worker intervals); repeated-call and synchronization checks. Planning declares; it does not implement: no compiler modules are created. No benchmark, timing, speedup or performance task is scheduled beyond the required multi-worker/specialized-instruction execution evidence.
inputs: docs/compiler-agent/PROJECT_STATE.json (facts, workload, api-spec, group order, case totals)
ops/ (corpus entry document and harness contract as recorded in the workload analysis)
outputs: Implementation task DAG submitted via task-submit in docs/compiler-agent/PROJECT_STATE.json
acceptance: COMPILER_ARCHITECTURE.md derives every target decision from recorded Facts (cited by id), covers frontend/IR levels/backend/runtime/allocation boundaries with producer/consumer interfaces, per-stage observability, RVV tails, applicable IME matrix lowering from cited specification, 1/2/4/8-worker partitioning with workspace ownership and merge semantics, program cache identity, and the a100_support integration route; no target value is invented.

ARCHITECTURE_CONSTRAINTS.json validates under `python3 -m compiler_agent --root . architecture-check --declaration-only` with zero errors; its ir_levels declare the basic optimization passes (CSE, DCE, constant folding/propagation, copy propagation, strength reduction, LICM) in the normal pipeline; its behaviour properties include a witness that fails when an operator-name branch is injected.

EXECUTION_MODEL.json is recorded via the execution-model command with work unit, workers_default, workers_max >= 2, mechanism, partition policies, synchronization, safety, fallback, and evidence citing recorded fact ids.

EXECUTION_RESOURCES.json exists, derived from facts: allowed_units (resource identities from sourced facts), minimum_workers between 2 and the allowed count, instruction_patterns containing at least one supported IME matrix-compute mnemonic, an evidence list citing active input facts, and shared_resources groups each citing active input facts.

The implementation DAG is submitted through task-submit and every task declares capability, purpose input (or advisory for optional diagnostics), gate, goal, acceptance and tests; dependencies reflect actual consumption with no dangling references or cycles; the vertical-slice task is tagged vertical-slice with gate G4; no task uses capability/purpose/tag optimization or gate G9; no task narrows the corpus, edits kernels/references/tolerances, or adds operator-name dispatch.

The DAG covers: vertical slice, matrix/IME slice, api-spec surface with frontend coverage matrix, basic optimizations as coding/input work, the driver and A100_COMPILER_FACTORY integration, regression prepare/record, parallel evidence and resource-evidence representative cases, and repeated-call/synchronization checks.
Planning created no compiler implementation modules; only declarations and engine state were written.
tests: PYTHONPATH from .env loaded, python3 -m compiler_agent --root . architecture-check --declaration-only reports zero errors
python3 -m compiler_agent --root . --json status shows the submitted implementation tasks with their gates/dependencies, and execution-model and execution-resources artifacts recorded
